environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet. S3 access is routed exclusively through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy. The endpoint policy document allows s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject ONLY when the condition aws:ResourceAccount equals '111222333444' AND the s3:prefix condition key starts with the value of aws:PrincipalTag/team-prefix (set to 'users/' on the task role). Additionally, the endpoint policy has an explicit Deny for any s3:PutObject where s3:prefix does NOT match 'users/${aws:PrincipalTag/user-scope}/*'. The task role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/S3ScopedBoundary) that denies s3:* on any bucket ARN not matching arn:aws:s3:::prod-user-assets-7f3a. Route tables have no NAT/IGW route for S3 CIDR ranges (pl-63a5400a), forcing all S3 traffic through the VPC endpoint exclusively.

config.vpc_endpoint: vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890, Gateway type, endpoint policy with s3:prefix condition and aws:ResourceAccount condition
config.endpoint_policy_deny: Explicit Deny on s3:PutObject where s3:prefix does not match 'users/${aws:PrincipalTag/user-scope}/*'
config.permission_boundary: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/S3ScopedBoundary - denies s3:* on non-matching bucket ARNs
config.network: private subnet, no NAT/IGW route for S3 prefix list, all S3 traffic forced through VPCE
config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Go 1.21, no input validation middleware
